translation:
(With fire it is good; thorn needle (棘針) is its envoy; it fears 毒公 (dúgōng), 矢 (shǐ), 虎掌 (hǔzhǎng), and 細辛 (xìxīn); it fears water.)

The original text of the 《Bencao Jing》: 石 (yùshí), flavor acrid, greatly hot. It governs cold-heat, rat fistula (鼠瘻), erosive sores, dead flesh, wind-bi (風痹), and abdominal...
